title: Testbed data and analysis code for "From Telemetry to Actionable Information"
description:
Raw SNMP readings, the fault event log, the two alerting rules (fixed limits and link baseline) and the analysis script that produces every table and figure in the paper From Telemetry to Actionable Information: An Exploratory Testbed Study of Predictive Signals for Link Faults in Mixed Fiber–Copper Networks (Ahmed Hassan, preprint, 2026).

Testbed: Cisco Catalyst 2960-X and TP-Link SG2428P joined by a single-mode fiber link, with a copper link to a PC; readings every 15 s over about 45 hours. Faults: fiber bend, copper duplex mismatch, damaged copper cable and a planned change on the fiber link. Device addresses and access credentials were removed.

Code is released under the MIT License; data and results under CC BY 4.0. The data-collection prototype is available from the author on request.
